levels.name: 零基础 · Pre-A1
levels.goal: 建立声音与意义的联系；能借助提示完成简短回应。
levels.canDo: 能不看文字问候、介绍自己、表达一个需要；没听懂时会请求重复。

levels.name: 起步 · A1
levels.goal: 用常用句型处理个人信息、点餐、时间与方向。
levels.canDo: 能完成自我介绍和简单交易；能听懂慢速、清楚的提问。

levels.name: 生活 · A2
levels.goal: 连接多句表达，在常见生活场景中追问、说明情况。
levels.canDo: 能在旅行、购物、预约中交换信息，描述经历和计划。

levels.name: 独立 · B1
levels.goal: 讲述经历、表达理由，遇到意外能澄清并继续交流。
levels.canDo: 能无脚本进行熟悉话题对话，叙述经历并说明观点。

levels.name: 深入 · B2
levels.goal: 表达细微差异、协商、讨论抽象问题并回应不同观点。
levels.canDo: 能持续交换意见，给出论据、确认隐含意思和修复误解。

levels.name: 进阶交流
levels.goal: 扩展话题、语域、语速与口音适应；练习真实互动。
levels.canDo: 能根据对象调整表达、处理打断和含蓄意见，准确复述对方立场。

lessons.title: 初次见面
lessons.note: I am + 名字，介绍自己；you 用来指对方。
lessons.focus: 句中重读名字；Hi 的 /aɪ/ 从开口滑向高位。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Mei.
What's your name?
Nice to meet you.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“初次见面”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 初次见面. Practise these communicative functions: Hi, I'm Mei.; What's your name?; Nice to meet you.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 我来自哪里
lessons.note: I am from + 地点，from 表示来自。
lessons.focus: from 轻读，重读城市名称；词尾 m 闭唇收尾。

sentences.en: I'm from China.
Where are you from?
I live in Beijing.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“我来自哪里”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 我来自哪里. Practise these communicative functions: I'm from China.; Where are you from?; I live in Beijing.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 表达需要
lessons.note: I need + 名词；please 让请求更礼貌。
lessons.focus: need 词尾 d 收住，不额外加元音。

sentences.en: I need some water.
Water, please.
Thank you very much.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“表达需要”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 表达需要. Practise these communicative functions: I need some water.; Water, please.; Thank you very much.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 是与不是
lessons.note: Yes / No 后加一个完整短句确认信息。
lessons.focus: this 的 /ð/ 轻咬舌尖并振动声带。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.

Is this yours?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“是与不是”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 是与不是. Practise these communicative functions: Yes, that's right.; No, thank you.; Is this yours?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 听不懂也能沟通
lessons.note: Could you + 动词，礼貌请对方帮忙；不要假装听懂。
lessons.focus: please 里的 /pl/ 连续发音，不插入元音。

sentences.en: Sorry, I don't understand.
Could you say that again?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“听不懂也能沟通”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 听不懂也能沟通. Practise these communicative functions: Sorry, I don't understand.; Could you say that again?; Please speak more slowly.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 数字与价格
lessons.note: How much is + 物品，询问价格；数字要确认。
lessons.focus: three 的 /θ/ 不振动声带，与 tree 区分。

sentences.en: One, two, three.
How much is this?
It's ten dollars.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“数字与价格”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 数字与价格. Practise these communicative functions: One, two, three.; How much is this?; It's ten dollars.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 找东西
lessons.note: Where is + 单个东西；here / there 表示位置。
lessons.focus: where 的 /w/ 收圆双唇；here 的 h 轻送气。

It's right here.
Is it over there?

lessons.scene: Role-play 找东西. Practise these communicative functions: Where is my phone?; It's right here.; Is it over there?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 第一段小对话
lessons.note: 用 and 把两个想法连起来；用简单句完成一个来回。
lessons.focus: 一句一个意群；不要每个单词都一样重。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Mei, and I'm a student.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是梅，是一名学生。

sentences.en: I speak a little English.
Can you help me, please?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“第一段小对话”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。

lessons.title: 介绍自己
lessons.note: I work / I study 描述日常；问句用 What do you do?。
lessons.focus: work 的 /w/ 与 v 不同；student 重读第一音节。

What do you do?
I study English every day.

lessons.scene: Role-play 介绍自己. Practise these communicative functions: I work in a shop.; What do you do?; I study English every day.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 家人和朋友
lessons.note: This is + 人，介绍别人；my / your 表示所属。
lessons.focus: brother 的 th 是浊音 /ð/；词尾 r 不卷得过重。

sentences.en: This is my sister.
She lives near me.
Do you have any brothers?

lessons.scene: Role-play 家人和朋友. Practise these communicative functions: This is my sister.; She lives near me.; Do you have any brothers?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 一天的安排
lessons.note: 一般现在时描述习惯；at + 时间。
lessons.focus: get up 连读，保留节奏；eight 词尾 t 不加元音。

sentences.en: I get up at seven.
I go to work at eight.

lessons.title: 在咖啡店
lessons.note: I'd like + 物品，比 I want 更适合点单。
lessons.focus: coffee 重读第一音节；please 词尾 /z/ 带振动。

Can I have it without sugar?

lessons.title: 问路与确认
lessons.note: How do I get to + 地点；确认左右和地标。
lessons.focus: right / light 区分 r 和 l；left 词尾 ft 连续收尾。

sentences.en: How do I get to the station?
Turn left at the next street.
Is it far from here?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“问路与确认”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。

lessons.title: 购买物品
lessons.note: Do you have + 物品；this one 代替刚指过的东西。
lessons.focus: size 词尾 /z/；this 和 these 元音不同。

sentences.en: Do you have this in blue?
Can I try it on?
I'll take this one.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“购买物品”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 购买物品. Practise these communicative functions: Do you have this in blue?; Can I try it on?; I'll take this one.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 约时间
lessons.note: Are you free + 时间；用具体时间避免含糊。
lessons.focus: Tuesday 重读第一音节；fifteen / fifty 重音不同。

sentences.en: Are you free on Friday?
Let's meet at three.
See you then.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“约时间”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 约时间. Practise these communicative functions: Are you free on Friday?; Let's meet at three.; See you then.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 爱好与追问
lessons.note: like + 动词 ing；追问 How about you? 保持互动。
lessons.focus: swimming 的 /ŋ/ 不添加 g；like 词尾 k 收住。

sentences.en: I like reading and swimming.
What do you do for fun?
How about you?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“爱好与追问”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 爱好与追问. Practise these communicative functions: I like reading and swimming.; What do you do for fun?; How about you?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 昨天发生了什么
lessons.note: 过去式描述已结束的事情；注意时间词 yesterday。
lessons.focus: worked 的 ed 是 /t/，visited 结尾是 /ɪd/。

sentences.en: I visited a friend yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天拜访了一位朋友。

sentences.en: We had lunch together.

lessons.scene: Role-play 昨天发生了什么. Practise these communicative functions: I visited a friend yesterday.; We had lunch together.; What did you do yesterday?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.note: going to + 动词，说明已有计划。
lessons.focus: going to 可自然轻读，但先练清楚完整形式。

sentences.en: I'm going to visit my parents.
What are your plans for the weekend?
We might go for a walk.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“周末计划”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 周末计划. Practise these communicative functions: I'm going to visit my parents.; What are your plans for the weekend?; We might go for a walk.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 酒店入住
lessons.note: I have a reservation；用 under + 姓名说明预订人。
lessons.focus: reservation 主重音在 va；连读 check in。

sentences.en: I have a reservation under Chen.
What time is breakfast?
Could I have a quiet room?
sentences.zh: 能给我一间安静的房间吗？

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“酒店入住”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 酒店入住. Practise these communicative functions: I have a reservation under Chen.; What time is breakfast?; Could I have a quiet room?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 餐厅里说明需求
lessons.note: Could I have + 需求；先说清楚不能吃什么。
lessons.focus: allergic 重读第二音节；nuts 词尾 ts 收清。

sentences.en: I'm allergic to peanuts.
Does this dish contain nuts?
Could we have the bill, please?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“餐厅里说明需求”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。

lessons.title: 交通与意外
lessons.note: missed / next / delayed 描述交通变化；确认目的地。
lessons.focus: train 的 /tr/ 连续发音；missed 词尾 /st/。

sentences.en: I think I missed my stop.

sentences.zh: 下一班火车是什么时候？

sentences.en: Does this bus go to the airport?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“交通与意外”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 交通与意外. Practise these communicative functions: I think I missed my stop.; When is the next train?; Does this bus go to the airport?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 预约和改期
lessons.note: I'd like to book；Could we move it to + 新时间。
lessons.focus: appointment 重读 point；日期与时间放慢确认。

sentences.en: I'd like to book an appointment.
Could we move it to Monday?
Is there anything available in the afternoon?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“预约和改期”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 预约和改期. Practise these communicative functions: I'd like to book an appointment.; Could we move it to Monday?; Is there anything available in the afternoon?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 描述身体不适
lessons.note: I've had + 症状 + for + 持续时间；表达症状而非自诊。
lessons.focus: throat 的 /θ/ 不变成 s；pain 双元音 /eɪ/。

sentences.en: I've had a headache since yesterday.
My throat hurts when I swallow.
Where is the nearest pharmacy?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“描述身体不适”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 描述身体不适. Practise these communicative functions: I've had a headache since yesterday.; My throat hurts when I swallow.; Where is the nearest pharmacy?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 说明问题和退换
lessons.note: It doesn't work；请求解决办法并保留礼貌。
lessons.focus: refund 作名词重读首音节；broken 重读 bro。

sentences.en: This doesn't seem to work.
sentences.zh: 这个好像不能正常使用。

sentences.en: Could I exchange it for another one?
I bought it here yesterday.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“说明问题和退换”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 说明问题和退换. Practise these communicative functions: This doesn't seem to work.; Could I exchange it for another one?; I bought it here yesterday.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 讲一段经历
lessons.note: 先背景，再事件，最后感受；用 while / when 连接。
lessons.focus: 意群之间稍停顿，不在每个词后停。

sentences.en: I was walking home when it started raining.
Luckily, a friend offered me a ride.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，一位朋友捎了我一程。

sentences.en: It turned out to be a memorable day.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“讲一段经历”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 讲一段经历. Practise these communicative functions: I was walking home when it started raining.; Luckily, a friend offered me a ride.; It turned out to be a memorable day.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 表达观点和理由
lessons.note: I think + 观点，because + 理由，并给一个例子。
lessons.focus: 重读观点关键词；because 通常轻读。

sentences.en: I think working from home can save time.
sentences.zh: 我认为在家工作能节省时间。

sentences.en: It depends on the kind of work you do.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你做什么工作。

sentences.en: For example, I spend less time commuting.
sentences.zh: 例如，我花在通勤上的时间更少了。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“表达观点和理由”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 表达观点和理由. Practise these communicative functions: I think working from home can save time.; It depends on the kind of work you do.; For example, I spend less time commuting.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.note: You could / Why don't we 提供选择，不替对方做决定。
lessons.focus: could 的 l 不发音；建议语气保持友好。

sentences.en: You could try taking a short break.
sentences.zh: 你可以试着休息一会儿。

sentences.en: Why don't we ask someone for advice?

sentences.en: What would you suggest?

lessons.scene: Role-play 提出建议. Practise these communicative functions: You could try taking a short break.; Why don't we ask someone for advice?; What would you suggest?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.note: What I meant was + 原意；用复述确认理解。

sentences.en: That's not quite what I meant.
Let me explain it another way.
Do you mean we should wait until tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你的意思是我们应该等到明天吗？

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“澄清误会”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 澄清误会. Practise these communicative functions: That's not quite what I meant.; Let me explain it another way.; Do you mean we should wait until tomorrow?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 工作进度

sentences.en: I've finished the first part of the project.
sentences.zh: 我已经完成项目的第一部分。

sentences.en: I'm still waiting for some information.

sentences.zh: 我会在星期五之前给你发进展。

lessons.scene: Role-play 工作进度. Practise these communicative functions: I've finished the first part of the project.; I'm still waiting for some information.; I'll send you an update by Friday.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 自然地闲聊
lessons.note: 从共同情境开始，追问一个细节，并分享相关经历。
lessons.focus: how's 的 /z/ 接 your，先清楚再练自然连读。

sentences.en: How's your week been so far?

sentences.zh: 听起来很有趣。你怎么开始接触它的？

sentences.en: I've always wanted to try that.

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“自然地闲聊”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 自然地闲聊. Practise these communicative functions: How's your week been so far?; That sounds interesting. How did you get into it?; I've always wanted to try that.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 陌生词也能表达
lessons.note: 用用途、外观或例子解释不会的词，避免直接停止。
lessons.focus: thing 的 /θ/ 与 /ŋ/；停顿用于组织思路。

sentences.en: I don't know the word, but it's used for cooking.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这个词，但它是做饭用的。

sentences.en: It's similar to a small oven.
What do you call that in English?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“陌生词也能表达”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 陌生词也能表达. Practise these communicative functions: I don't know the word, but it's used for cooking.; It's similar to a small oven.; What do you call that in English?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 面对突发变化
lessons.note: 说明变化、影响、可行替代；明确请求确认。
lessons.focus: changed 结尾 /dʒd/ 不增加音节。

sentences.en: Our plans have changed at the last minute.
sentences.zh: 我们的计划在最后一刻变了。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to meet online instead?
sentences.zh: 我们改成线上见面可以吗？

sentences.en: Let me know what works best for you.
sentences.zh: 告诉我怎样安排最适合你。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“面对突发变化”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 面对突发变化. Practise these communicative functions: Our plans have changed at the last minute.; Would it be possible to meet online instead?; Let me know what works best for you.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 比较与权衡
lessons.note: On the one hand / on the other hand；比较成本和收益。
lessons.focus: 重读对比词，连接词轻读；costs 词尾不要漏掉。

sentences.en: The cheaper option may cost more in the long run.
sentences.zh: 便宜的方案长期来看可能更贵。

sentences.en: We need to weigh the benefits against the risks.
sentences.zh: 我们需要权衡收益和风险。

sentences.en: What matters most is whether it meets our needs.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是它是否符合我们的需求。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“比较与权衡”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 比较与权衡. Practise these communicative functions: The cheaper option may cost more in the long run.; We need to weigh the benefits against the risks.; What matters most is whether it meets our needs.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 有分寸地不同意
lessons.note: 先承认合理部分，再提出疑问和理由。
lessons.focus: 语调平稳，避免每句都像命令。

sentences.en: I see your point, but I'm not entirely convinced.
sentences.zh: 我理解你的观点，但还没有完全被说服。

sentences.en: My main concern is how this would work in practice.
sentences.zh: 我主要担心实际操作会怎样。

sentences.en: Could we look at it from another perspective?

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“有分寸地不同意”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 有分寸地不同意. Practise these communicative functions: I see your point, but I'm not entirely convinced.; My main concern is how this would work in practice.; Could we look at it from another perspective?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 协商与达成一致
lessons.note: If + 条件，we could + 方案；复述双方承诺。
lessons.focus: 条件和结论分意群；重读条件中的数量或日期。

sentences.en: If we extend the deadline, we could improve the quality.
sentences.zh: 如果延长截止时间，我们就能提高质量。

sentences.en: Would you be willing to consider a compromise?
sentences.zh: 你愿意考虑折中方案吗？

sentences.en: Let's agree on the next steps before we finish.
sentences.zh: 结束前我们来确认下一步。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“协商与达成一致”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 协商与达成一致. Practise these communicative functions: If we extend the deadline, we could improve the quality.; Would you be willing to consider a compromise?; Let's agree on the next steps before we finish.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 说明复杂流程
lessons.note: 先概述目标，再按步骤解释，检查对方是否跟上。
lessons.focus: process 美式常读 /prɑːses/；重点是清楚的意群。

sentences.en: The process consists of three main stages.
sentences.zh: 这个流程包括三个主要阶段。

sentences.en: Once you've completed this step, you can move on.
sentences.zh: 完成这一步后，就可以继续了。

sentences.en: Would it help if I walked you through an example?
sentences.zh: 我带你过一个例子会有帮助吗？

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“说明复杂流程”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 说明复杂流程. Practise these communicative functions: The process consists of three main stages.; Once you've completed this step, you can move on.; Would it help if I walked you through an example?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 媒体与信息判断
lessons.note: 区分事实、观点与不确定性；询问信息来源。
lessons.focus: evidence 重读首音节；claim 结尾 m 闭唇。

sentences.en: I'm not sure how reliable that source is.
sentences.zh: 我不确定那个来源有多可靠。

sentences.en: The evidence seems to support a different conclusion.
sentences.zh: 证据似乎支持另一个结论。

sentences.en: We should distinguish between facts and opinions.
sentences.zh: 我们应该区分事实和观点。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“媒体与信息判断”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 媒体与信息判断. Practise these communicative functions: I'm not sure how reliable that source is.; The evidence seems to support a different conclusion.; We should distinguish between facts and opinions.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 谈文化差异
lessons.note: 描述个人经验，避免把一群人都说成同一种情况。
lessons.focus: culture 重读首音节；不同口音都可以清晰可懂。

sentences.en: In my experience, expectations vary from place to place.
sentences.zh: 依我看，不同地方的期望有所不同。

sentences.en: I wouldn't want to make a generalization.
How is that usually handled where you live?
sentences.zh: 你住的地方通常怎么处理那种情况？

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“谈文化差异”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 谈文化差异. Practise these communicative functions: In my experience, expectations vary from place to place.; I wouldn't want to make a generalization.; How is that usually handled where you live?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 反馈与建设性表达
lessons.note: 描述具体行为和影响，再提出可执行的改变。
lessons.focus: 反馈重读行为而非指责对方的人格。

sentences.en: I appreciated how clearly you explained the problem.
sentences.zh: 我很欣赏你把问题解释得那么清楚。

sentences.en: One thing we could improve is the handover process.
sentences.zh: 我们可以改进的一点是交接流程。

sentences.en: Could we set aside some time to discuss this?
sentences.zh: 我们能留点时间讨论一下吗？

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“反馈与建设性表达”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 反馈与建设性表达. Practise these communicative functions: I appreciated how clearly you explained the problem.; One thing we could improve is the handover process.; Could we set aside some time to discuss this?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 深入追问
lessons.note: 用具体细节、原因和反例把对话推进一层。
lessons.focus: 问句不一定都升调，开放式提问可自然降调。

sentences.en: What led you to that conclusion?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你得出了那个结论？

sentences.en: Could you give me a concrete example?
sentences.zh: 你能给我一个具体的例子吗？

sentences.en: How would your view change if the situation were different?
sentences.zh: 如果情况不同，你的看法会怎样改变？

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“深入追问”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 深入追问. Practise these communicative functions: What led you to that conclusion?; Could you give me a concrete example?; How would your view change if the situation were different?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 听懂隐含意思
lessons.note: 先提出你理解的意思，让对方确认，避免猜测当事实。
lessons.focus: 重音会改变暗示；同一句换重音再听。

sentences.en: Are you suggesting that we should reconsider?
sentences.zh: 你是在建议我们重新考虑吗？

sentences.en: I get the impression that you have some reservations.
Please correct me if I've misunderstood.
sentences.zh: 如果我理解错了，请纠正我。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“听懂隐含意思”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 听懂隐含意思. Practise these communicative functions: Are you suggesting that we should reconsider?; I get the impression that you have some reservations.; Please correct me if I've misunderstood.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 插话和重新接续
lessons.note: 礼貌进入话轮；被打断后用 returning to 回到重点。
lessons.focus: 插话用短句，自然停顿给对方回应空间。

sentences.en: Sorry to jump in, but could I clarify one point?
sentences.zh: 抱歉插一句，我能澄清一点吗？

sentences.en: Please go ahead. I'll come back to that later.
sentences.zh: 请继续。我稍后再回到那一点。

sentences.en: Returning to what we were discussing earlier...
sentences.zh: 回到我们刚才讨论的内容……

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“插话和重新接续”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 插话和重新接续. Practise these communicative functions: Sorry to jump in, but could I clarify one point?; Please go ahead. I'll come back to that later.; Returning to what we were discussing earlier.... Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 精确表达不确定性
lessons.note: 区分可能、较可能与已知；不要用绝对词掩盖不确定。
lessons.focus: potentially 主重音在 ten；probably 可自然弱化。

sentences.en: As far as I can tell, the situation hasn't changed.
sentences.zh: 据我判断，情况还没有变化。

sentences.en: That's plausible, though we don't have enough evidence yet.
sentences.zh: 那是有可能的，不过我们还没有足够证据。

sentences.en: I'd be hesitant to draw a firm conclusion at this stage.
sentences.zh: 我不愿在这个阶段就下定论。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“精确表达不确定性”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 精确表达不确定性. Practise these communicative functions: As far as I can tell, the situation hasn't changed.; That's plausible, though we don't have enough evidence yet.; I'd be hesitant to draw a firm conclusion at this stage.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 讲故事的节奏
lessons.note: 铺垫、转折、结果；省掉不必要细节并观察对方反应。
lessons.focus: 转折前稍停顿，用重音突出意外信息。

sentences.en: What I hadn't realized was that we'd met before.
sentences.zh: 我没想到的是我们以前见过。

sentences.en: Just when I thought it was over, something unexpected happened.
sentences.zh: 就在我以为结束时，意想不到的事发生了。

sentences.en: Looking back, that's what made the experience worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 回头看，那正是这段经历值得的原因。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“讲故事的节奏”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 讲故事的节奏. Practise these communicative functions: What I hadn't realized was that we'd met before.; Just when I thought it was over, something unexpected happened.; Looking back, that's what made the experience worthwhile.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 调整正式程度
lessons.note: 朋友、同事、客户用不同措辞；意思相同但语气有别。
lessons.focus: 礼貌来自措辞与语调，不必把每个词读得很慢。

sentences.en: Could you send me the details when you have a moment?
sentences.zh: 你方便时能把详情发给我吗？

sentences.en: I'd appreciate it if you could confirm receipt.
sentences.zh: 如果你能确认收到，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: Just checking whether you got my message.
sentences.zh: 只是想确认你是否收到我的消息。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“调整正式程度”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 调整正式程度. Practise these communicative functions: Could you send me the details when you have a moment?; I'd appreciate it if you could confirm receipt.; Just checking whether you got my message.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 适应不同表达和口音
lessons.note: 先抓关键词和意群；请求重复具体部分，而非整段重来。
lessons.focus: 清晰可懂优先于模仿单一口音；自然弱读需要反复听。

sentences.en: I caught the first part, but missed the last detail.
sentences.zh: 前半部分我听懂了，但漏掉了最后一个细节。

sentences.en: Could you rephrase the bit about the schedule?
sentences.zh: 关于日程的那一部分，你能换个说法吗？

sentences.en: So, if I've understood correctly, we're meeting at noon.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果我理解对了，我们中午见面。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“适应不同表达和口音”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 适应不同表达和口音. Practise these communicative functions: I caught the first part, but missed the last detail.; Could you rephrase the bit about the schedule?; So, if I've understood correctly, we're meeting at noon.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 敏感分歧中的沟通
lessons.note: 说明自己的理解，承认差异，询问对方在意的事。
lessons.focus: 语速略放慢，留回应空间；不要靠提高音量加强观点。

sentences.en: I can see why this matters to you.
sentences.zh: 我理解为什么这对你很重要。

sentences.en: We may disagree on the approach, but we share the same goal.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法可能不同，但目标相同。

sentences.en: What would a fair outcome look like to you?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，什么结果才算公平？

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“敏感分歧中的沟通”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 敏感分歧中的沟通. Practise these communicative functions: I can see why this matters to you.; We may disagree on the approach, but we share the same goal.; What would a fair outcome look like to you?. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.

lessons.title: 真实交流综合任务
lessons.note: 不看脚本：提出话题、追问、澄清、总结、约定下一步。
lessons.focus: 回听一段完整对话，只选择最影响理解的一处改进。

sentences.en: Let me make sure we're on the same page.
sentences.zh: 让我确认一下我们理解一致。

sentences.en: Is there anything important that we haven't covered?
sentences.zh: 还有什么重要的内容我们没有谈到吗？

sentences.en: It's been great talking with you. Let's stay in touch.
sentences.zh: 和你聊天很愉快。我们保持联系吧。

lessons.task: 不看英文，用自己的信息完成“真实交流综合任务”场景；至少回应三轮，追问一次。如果没听懂，主动澄清。
lessons.scene: Role-play 真实交流综合任务. Practise these communicative functions: Let me make sure we're on the same page.; Is there anything important that we haven't covered?; It's been great talking with you. Let's stay in touch.. Change names, numbers and details; do not make the learner merely repeat a script.
